threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look around for a bus stop sign instead of a handwritten 'bus stop' chalkboard outside the pub. That's a sure newbie giveaway.
Caught a lad on the 3 bus singing an opera aria at 2 AM, completely off-key but so passionate that half the bus joined in. Classic Brixton moment!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I heard the unmistakable sound of a saxophonist jamming from a rooftop during the weekend flea market. That’s Neukölln in a nutshell.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find spontaneous techno parties in abandoned buildings, complete with a makeshift bar and a DJ in the corner. It's pure magic.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local when they know that the N-Judah is just as unreliable as the weather here—both can ruin your day without warning.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Last week, I saw a dog on a leash riding the 16th Street bus, calmly watching the streetcars. Only in SF do you see pooches treating transit like a joyride.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí. They miss the quiet corners where locals sip coffee and debate politics like it’s a sport.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're recent when they still think it's a good idea to walk around with a map, even though Google Maps is everywhere.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the Tube is reliable—bless your heart! It’s not just delays, it’s a lifestyle choice out here.
Caught a glimpse of two guys arguing about the best kebab shop on Night Bus 77. One swore by the one near Balham, while the other claimed it was all about the one on Clapham High Street.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was truly home when the street vendor remembered my order—beers for me and the same currywurst for my mate. Little things, you know?

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a kebab shop that serves late-night currywurst topped with döner meat. It's a wild fusion, but somehow it works.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows to avoid Valencia during rush hour—those bike lanes become instant gridlock. Tourists just seem confused.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy in the Tenderloin juggling three oranges on the bus while discussing a side gig. Only in SF do Muni rides come with a side of entertainment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can conquer Gràcia in a day, but really, it takes weeks to find all the hidden plazas and local secrets tucked away from the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell a newbie—they're the ones staring at the metro map like it's a cryptic treasure map, completely lost in L5.
